meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 当用户要求整理会议纪要，Claude会汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要，生成结构化报告（单日输出“今日会议概览”，多日输出“会议纪要周报”，列出会议时间、主题、纪要/逐字稿链接等），也可按需写入云文档。
howto.when: 当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要。
say.note: 会汇总本周会议并生成周报。
会汇总上周的会议并生成周报。

howto.what_en: When asked to compile meeting notes, Claude aggregates notes from the given time range into a structured report (daily or weekly) including meeting time, topic, note/transcript links. It can also create/update a cloud document if asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to compile meeting minutes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings over a period.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes.
say_en.note: It will make a weekly report for this week.
It will summarize last week's meetings.
